summary: DescribeTaskQueueAsync does not populate the Stats field in the response even when ReportStats is set to true, requiring users to use deprecated API modes to retrieve task queue statistics.
userImpact: Users cannot retrieve task queue statistics through the standard API and must resort to using deprecated API methods.
workaround: Set ApiMode to DescribeTaskQueueMode.Enhanced and access stats through VersionsInfo[string].TypesInfo[(int)queueType].Stats instead of the Stats property.
keyQuote: The following block seems to retrieve what we need. But it leverages **obsolete** objects/properties/API.
